lede: The biggest thing on the board this week is Telluride Town Council's third and final reading of the Colorado Wildfire Resiliency Code on Tuesday — if it passes, it rewrites the Land Use Code's historic review standards and landscaping rules for every property owner in town. Ridgway's council is also holding a public hearing on the Hyde Subdivision resubdivision and a joint work session on its draft Housing Action Plan, while San Miguel County's Planning Commission takes up both a subdivision work session and an energy code update that would reshape building standards for new construction.

notable.stake: Third reading — LUC historic review and landscaping rules permanently change if approved.
